caption: The drawing depicts a long, brown dress with a fitted bodice, full-length sleeves, and a flared skirt, all adorned with a small repeating diamond-shaped pattern. The dress has a gathered waist and a white, ruffled lace collar. To the right of the dress are three separate illustrations: at the top, a square with a sketch of an embroidered or decorative floral pattern; below that, a filled-in brown square containing an arrangement of small yellowish dots in a grid or geometric pattern; and at the bottom, an outlined technical drawing of the dress viewed from the back, rendered in thin, black lines. The background of the drawing is a plain, off-white or beige color. The objects are spaced apart with the dress centrally positioned, dominating the composition, and the three supplementary illustrations grouped vertically to its right.
title: Dress
